name: Fed-balance-sheet expansion impulse — long crypto beta when WALCL is re-expanding (independent liquidity read)
rationale: MECHANISM: a distinct liquidity axis from the WALCL-TGA net-liquidity composite — here the raw fed_balance_sheet_usd rate-of-change isolates the Fed's own balance-sheet re-expansion (QE / stealth-easing / facility usage) that mechanically adds reserves, independent of the volatile TGA drain leg. When the balance sheet turns up, dealer balance-sheet capacity expands and the highest-beta liquidity sponge (crypto) re-rates. The counterparty is the same slow-clock TradFi allocator set. Trade: gate crypto-beta longs on fed_balance_sheet_usd RoC positive AND a confirming crypto trend (adx building). DISCONFIRMER: fed_balance_sheet_usd is a weekly, revision-prone FRED series with a next-availability lag — most of the lead is gone by the PIT bar. Kill if it adds no OOS lift over the net-liquidity composite variant (hh-macro-01) — if the two liquidity reads are the same trade, keep only the stronger. Also kill if the signal only worked during 2020-2021 outright QE (2026 has no active QE program).
catalyst: Fed balance sheet re-expanding into a confirmed crypto trend
